description: This file defines the AlertingClient class, which interacts asynchronously with an internal alerting service API using HTTP requests. It handles configuration retrieval, sending trigger requests, and error handling.

classes.name: AlertingClient
classes.description: HTTP client for alerting_service internal API, enabling trigger actions via asynchronous HTTP requests.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the AlertingClient with an asynchronous HTTP client with a timeout of 30 seconds.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Closes the internal HTTP client asynchronously.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] trigger(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a trigger payload to the alerting service and returns the response as a dictionary. Raises HTTP exceptions on errors.

ctags.name: trigger
ctags.pattern: /^    async def trigger(self, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
